text: 金十数据11月2日讯，A股市场今日整体高开高走，午盘前集体拉升创业板指涨超3%，午后股指涨幅有所收窄。截至收盘，沪指收涨1.08%，深证成指收涨1.63%，创业板指收涨1.87%；沪深两市成交额超1.7万亿，全市场超4600只个股上涨。盘面上，AI应用板块领涨大盘，影视院线板块集体爆发，博纳影业、中视传媒等多只个股涨停；游戏、文化传媒板块涨幅居前；银行板块高开低走，贵金属板块全天表现低迷。
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 2 - The A-share market opened higher and moved upward overall today, with a collective rally before the midday break pushing the ChiNext Index up over 3%, while index gains narrowed somewhat in the afternoon. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.08%, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.63%, and the ChiNext Index rose 1.87%; turnover across the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets exceeded 1.7 trillion yuan, with more than 4,600 stocks across the market advancing. On the board, the AI application sector led the broader market, the film and cinema chain sector surged collectively, with multiple stocks such as Bona Film Group and China Television Media hitting the daily limit; the gaming and cultural media sectors ranked among the top gainers; the banking sector opened higher but closed lower, while the precious metals sector remained weak throughout the day.
